scopeLimitations: One desktop/Edge/version/profile and one deterministic Indicator fixture; no population or maximum-capacity claim.
One unrepaired predecessor plus 100 replay replacements and 100 actual repairs; retained inventory is fixed at one original per repaired owner.
Separate accumulated 64 inventory, measurement/save/load and Q30 extension belong to the preserved r3 workload.
Matched post-GC baseline is completed repair 1; checkpoints 1/25/50/75/100 have identical public state.
CDP heap/DOM counters are browser proxies; no application retained-object identity, active solver count or captured stale callback is inspected.
Input-action latency is the maintained automation wall-time proxy, not browser Event Timing latency.
Screenshots require root visual inspection; the maintained startup-menu screenshot plus paired repair 1/100 screenshots are retained.
Operation 900s/cleanup 120s require the root-supplied 1020s hard native process owner.
